title: University of Bath: Step into Bath
canonical_name: University of Bath -- Step into Bath

proposed_updates.citizenship_restrictions: No explicit nationality/citizenship bar found, but the eligibility text is framed entirely around the UK 'Year 12' curriculum year and 'taking the relevant A levels (or equivalent) for your chosen course, on track to meet the typical offer.' This is distinct from the university's other, explicitly UK-widening-participation-restricted program (Discover Bath) -- Step into Bath is described as open to 'any Year 12 student' as a contrast to that stricter program, which suggests it is not nationality-gated, but the entire framing assumes a UK-style academic year/qualification structure that a Turkish-curriculum (or IB/AP) student would need to map onto, and this was not addressed anywhere found.
proposed_updates.cost_currency_note: GBP, unchanged from existing DB value, not re-verified this session.
proposed_updates.current_cycle_label: 'Applications for 2026 are now closed'; a future cycle's applications are 'likely to open in January [of the relevant year].'

turkey_access_reasoning: Genuinely ambiguous rather than a clean resolution either way: no citizenship/nationality bar was found (unlike Barrett or Boys State's clearer patterns), but the eligibility criteria are written entirely in UK curriculum terms ('Year 12', 'A levels or equivalent', 'on track to meet the typical offer') with no stated mapping for a non-UK-curriculum international applicant, and this is explicitly contrasted against the university's other, more clearly UK-restricted widening-participation program (Discover Bath). Recording UNCLEAR rather than guessing that 'or equivalent' silently covers a Turkish curriculum.

evidence.claim: UK-curriculum-framed eligibility, contrasted with the university's more restricted widening-participation program
evidence.quote: Step into Bath is available if you are a Year 12/Lower Sixth student who is on track to meet the typical offer for your chosen course...taking the relevant A levels (or equivalent) for your chosen course. [...] Step into Bath is open to any Year 12 student, unlike the university's other summer school programs [i.e. Discover Bath, which does carry UK widening-participation eligibility criteria].
